title: Visualization Audit Report
description: ANALYZE-stage artifact (advisory). Output of visualization-auditor. Checks figure specs against domain profile metric valid_range to detect misleading axis truncation. axis_truncation_flags are derived mechanically by viz_audit.py; verdict is advisory (not a hard gate).

declared_min.description: The axis minimum declared in the figure spec

valid_min.description: The valid_range minimum from the domain profile for this metric

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of the truncation concern

axis_truncation_flags.description: Each entry is a figure/metric pair where axis truncation was detected

clean.description: True iff no axis_truncation_flags found — derived, not hand-set

notes.description: Advisory notes from the visualization auditor
